claims.claim: Stellar Wallets Kit modules are supplied by each website at init. Upstream registration adds a module to a Kit release, not to deployed websites.
claims.evidence: README: StellarWalletsKit.init({modules: defaultModules()}); src/sdk/modules/utils.ts defaultModules() lists built-in modules; docs/files/wallets/create-wallet-module.md: 'open a PR with the module and we will review'
claims.deployment_note: A deployed website bundle keeps the Kit version and modules it shipped with. It gains a new module only after the site imports that module or updates its Kit dependency, then rebuilds and redeploys. This is an inference from the init-time module list, not a separately tested case.
claims.interface: ModuleInterface requires isAvailable (under 1000 ms), getAddress, signTransaction, signAuthEntry, signMessage, and getNetwork; disconnect is optional

claims.claim: SEP-43 and Freighter signAuthEntry sign a HashIdPreimageSorobanAuthorization preimage and return a signed hash, not a complete authorization entry.
claims.current: SEP-43 v1.2.1, status Draft; last file commit d4d17e6c73a0 on 2025-06-17
claims.evidence: sep-0043.md 'signAuthEntry' section; Freighter guide: call signAuthEntry(preimageXdr); returns a Buffer of the signed hash
claims.contrast: Walleterm signAuthEntry requires a complete unsigned AddressV2 entry plus an adapter, and verifies the complete returned entry (docs/CONTRACT-AUTHORIZATION.md)

claims.claim: Cloudflare documents no Quick Tunnel 401 response.
